scope: LO Drell-Yan cross section d2sigma/dM dy for photon exchange, derived from PDG Eqs. 51.3 and 51.40 (analytic derivation, Jacobian checked numerically on synthetic toy densities), and the lepton angular coefficients lambda, nu at O(alpha_s) in the quark-axis picture of Peng, Chang, McClellan and Teryaev (Eqs. 1-10): Eq. 5 and Eqs. 6-7 reproduced in SymPy, the Lam-Tung relation 1 - lambda - 2 nu = 0 for a coplanar quark axis (perturbative argument at O(alpha_s), coplanarity cited), and the per-channel closed forms checked against the published Eq. 10.
exclusions: Z exchange and gamma-Z interference (a = 0); W production
NLO corrections to the cross section, qT resummation, intrinsic transverse momentum, Boer-Mulders and other TMD effects
Lam-Tung violation beyond O(alpha_s) (only its sign, 1 - lambda - 2 nu >= 0 within the quark-axis representation, is derived)
Fits of channel mixtures or A2/A0 to measured distributions; any comparison with data
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field

capabilities.name: lo-cross-section
capabilities.scope: SymPy: colour average, Jacobian dx1 dx2 = dtau dy and the delta-function integration give d2sigma/dM dy = (8 pi alpha^2/(9 M s)) sum e_q^2 [q1 qbar2 + qbar1 q2] (analytic derivation); numerical box integral against the parton integral on SYNTHETIC toy densities (relative tolerance 1e-8)

capabilities.name: angular-coefficients-and-lam-tung
capabilities.scope: SymPy: Peng et al. Eq. 4 into Eq. 2 gives Eq. 5; A_0..A_7 (Eq. 6) and lambda, mu, nu (Eq. 7) read off; 1 - lambda - 2 nu = 4 (A0 - A2)/(2 + A0), >= 0 within the quark-axis representation and = 0 for phi1 = 0 (Lam-Tung, perturbative argument at O(alpha_s), coplanarity cited); Eqs. 8-9 give Eq. 10 for both channels; channel mixtures are exact cross-section-weighted A_i averages (analytic derivation)

capabilities.name: published-closed-form-benchmark
capabilities.scope: lambda and nu of the q qbar and q g channels at 7 qT/Q values against the published closed form, Peng et al. Eq. 10 (benchmarks/peng-eq10.json, relative tolerance 1e-12); the benchmark follows the same route as the profile, so it checks algebra and transcription, not the physics of Eq. 9
